title: Rockstar reveals 27 minutes of GTA 6 gameplay and confirms 2025 release date
summary: The extensive trailer shows a Vice City three times larger than Red Dead Redemption 2, a protagonist relationship system, and unprecedented realism mechanics.

title: Hacker Cyberleek withdraws $250,000 in cryptocurrency and ends GTA 6 leaks
summary: The person responsible for the massive 2022 leaks cashes out profits and abandons the project, leaving the associated memecoin collapsed.

title: GTA 6 extended trailer boosts Netflix mobile viewership by 35% and saturates platform
summary: The exclusive premiere of 30 minutes of gameplay triggers a traffic spike that temporarily brings down the streaming service.

title: CD Projekt shows 'Songs of the Past' behind closed doors, the new Witcher 3 expansion that reinvents the formula
summary: The expansion promises not to repeat previous patterns and arrives alongside a remaster that renders the best community HD mod obsolete.

title: Star Wars Zero Company bets on 'playing with toys' feeling instead of imitating movies
summary: The new turn-based strategy game moves away from film canon to offer tactical freedom and class customization.

title: Xbox launches feature to convert physical discs into digital licenses on Xbox One and Series X|S
summary: The feature allows preserving the physical library by granting digital access, part of Microsoft's commitment to video game preservation.

title: Dwarf Fortress receives its largest update: unique procedural magic system for each world
summary: The 'Myth and Magic' update introduces procedurally generated cosmologies that define magic differently for each playthrough.

title: Konami plans to release a new Silent Hill every year and promises 'positive surprises' to calm fans
summary: Producer Motoi Okamoto confirms annual cadence alongside additional 'experiences,' seeking to avoid skepticism after previous projects.

title: Crimson Desert will reduce free updates to focus on paid DLC, according to Pearl Abyss
summary: The Korean studio changes its post-launch support model to 'control the pace' and prepare larger-scale premium content.

title: Devolver Digital announces 'Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed' as ironic GTA 6 competitor for same launch day
summary: The action platformer presents itself as a light alternative to Rockstar's blockbuster, while Devolver reveals a 'remaster of a nonexistent remake'.

title: Panic refunds tariffs to Playdate customers and criticizes U.S. trade policy
summary: The handheld console manufacturer returns the surcharge imposed by tariffs, claiming 'it's not our money to keep'.

title: Trump considers new tariffs on video game hardware that could raise console and component prices
summary: The industry warns that a new round of tariffs would raise consumer prices in a market already strained by production costs.

title: Warlock impresses in first preview: an open-world D&D Action-RPG with deep and ambitious magic
summary: The game from the creators of The Witcher 3 stands out for its D&D-based magic system and a scale aspiring to surpass Baldur's Gate 3.

title: The Séance of Blake Manor arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 27 with physical Steelbook edition
summary: The acclaimed narrative mystery and horror game confirms its version for Nintendo's new console alongside a Steelbook release.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Wrath of the Mutants – Ninja Edition arrives on Switch 2 on September 4
summary: The enhanced version of the beat 'em up includes exclusive content and launches alongside the Dispatch Steelbook edition on the new console.
